artworks.title: Resting Cows
artworks.description: The image shows a group of cattle resting and standing in a grassy area. In the background, a rolling landscape with trees and a structure can be seen. The sky above has intricate line work forming cloud patterns. Two figures are seated under a tree to the right. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and white emphasizing texture.

artworks.title: The Happy Patriot
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a dynamic pose. He has one foot on the ground and the other lifted, twisting slightly to one side. His head is tilted back slightly with his eyes closed. He has long, wavy hair and is wearing a tunic, pants, and holding a hat in his left hand and a vessel in his right hand. The background includes cliffs on the left, a campsite with tents and a horse on the right, and swirling clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Rinaldo and Armida
artworks.description: The image depicts two central figures with most of their bodies visible. One person is seated on the ground and leans back slightly with their legs extended, their arm resting on the other's shoulder. The other person kneels next to them, partially leaning over with their arm raised above the other's head. The facial features of the person on the left include a calm expression, and they have loose, wavy hair. Both individuals are dressed in flowing garments. No specific jewelry or objects are evident except some drapery on the ground. In the background, there are dense, wooded trees, rocky formations, and faint figures that seem to be observing from a distance.

artworks.title: Frontispiece
artworks.description: The image depicts an architectural setting with elaborate structures, including a grand building with a two-story facade, columns, and decorative panels. A fountain with cascading water and sculpted horses is at the center. The style features precise line work and attention to detail, reminiscent of engravings. The color palette is mainly sepia and black. Figures in period attire are seen in the foreground, and trees frame the composition.

artworks.title: Landscape with Horsemen and Bridge
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with several figures on horseback under a canopy of trees. A structure is seen on the right with a person on its steps, interacting with the riders. A bridge spans a body of water on the left, leading to a more open landscape. A solitary figure walks towards the bridge while another stands near a tree. In the distance, a horizon is lined with trees and the sky above is vast. The etching is monochromatic, using intricate line work for textures and forms, hatching for shadows, and depth.

artworks.title: Landscape with Church and Town in Distance
artworks.description: The image depicts a panoramic landscape from a slightly elevated viewpoint. A chapel with a tiled roof and a cross is seen on the left, with figures nearby. In the distance, a river winds through the terrain with trees scattered along its banks. The horizon is high, showing buildings and hills far off. The etching technique uses fine lines and cross-hatching to define shapes and textures in a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: Landscape with Chateau
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a castle-like structure on the right side. The horizon is high in the composition with more landscape and distant trees. The style is detailed with line work and etching. A figure tends to sheep in the foreground, with a body of water reflecting nearby structures. A bridge leads to the castle with cylindrical towers and pointed rooftops. The color palette is sepia and black, with trees framing the left side.

artworks.title: Landscape with Houses
artworks.description: The image shows a small village with a mountainous backdrop. A tall tree with gnarled branches is in the foreground, with village houses slightly behind it. The houses have simple designs with clear lines and wooden textures. A pathway leads towards the horizon, where mountains rise in the distance. The color scheme is monochrome, emphasizing black and white. The detailed etching technique highlights texture, depth, dimension, and perspective in the scene.

artworks.title: Landscape with Classical Ruins
artworks.description: The image shows a classical architectural scene with detailed structures and a vast landscape. The horizon is low in the scene, with distant mountains and a winding river. Close by are ruins of a grand building with upright and fallen columns, with vegetation growing around them. A series of columns to the right extend into the distance, and two figures stand on the stone surface. The etching technique includes hatched shading and precise lines for details. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of black and grey, creating a timeless appearance.

artworks.title: Landscape with City in Distance
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a landscape with an architectural structure, trees, a path, cityscape on the horizon, and birds flying in the sky. The etching features precise linework detailing the scenery.

artworks.title: Mountain Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape with a rocky inlet between high cliffs. The horizon is under a cloudy sky with sailing ships at sea. On the horizon, there are structures on cliffs. The detailed etching shows texture on rocks, water, and clouds. The color scheme is monochromatic, emphasizing light and dark contrast via lines. A goat is on a nearby rocky outcrop with a waterfall cascading down a cliff. The scene extends towards the sea.

artworks.title: Landscape with Temple Ruins and Pond
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of classical architecture in a wooded landscape. The composition includes stone buildings with arches and columns, alongside dense trees. A man on a platform by water points towards a swan-like figure. The etching technique uses fine lines and crosshatching to create texture, shadow, and depth with a monochrome palette of black and white.

artworks.title: Landscape with Classical Ruins
artworks.description: The image depicts a classical architectural ruin with arches, columns, and statues. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing the remnants of the structure. Clouds and birds are visible in the sky. In the distance, there are more architectural structures, including a rectangular building and an obelisk. The image is detailed with fine linework typical of an etching technique, and the color palette is monochromatic. Rubble and vegetation can be seen closer to the viewer, leading to the ruins and city elements in the distance.

artworks.title: Landscape with Monastery
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape featuring an elaborate architectural structure at the center. The horizon is positioned below the midpoint, meeting the building's base and a distant cityscape. The building has a central dome and smaller turrets with detailed engravings. Two figures on horseback are shown near the building, and to the right, a pyramid-like structure is visible, followed by trees. In the background, faint outlines of distant buildings are present. The style is detailed with fine linework and a monochrome palette of black ink on a pale background, giving a classic look. The sky is mostly clear with minimal detailing.

artworks.title: Landscape with an Army
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of mounted soldiers. A rider on horseback is on the left under a tree. In the center and in the distance, soldiers on horseback, some holding standards, are visible. The horizon is high with smoke plumes and a distant architectural silhouette. The artwork features detailed linework in a monochromatic color scheme.

artworks.title: Saint Anthony of Padua
artworks.medium: etching printed from two plates on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a man and a child. The man is depicted kneeling, holding the child close to his face. He has a short beard and mustache, with hair cropped short and a halo around his head. The child is standing on a surface, reaching out towards the man. The child has curly hair, a halo around the head, and wears a draped cloth. The man is dressed in robes, and on the right side, there is a draped table with a small crucifix. Above them, a group of three angels and a crowned figure are seen amidst swirling clouds. The background has detailed lines, creating an ethereal setting enhanced by the celestial figures and clouds.

artworks.title: Marin Cureau de la Chambre
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in a three-quarter view. The man has distinct facial features, long hair, and wears a cap. He is depicted in formal attire with a broad white collar and a detailed robe. The background includes an oval frame with Latin inscriptions and a decorative emblem or coat of arms. The portrait is rendered in a detailed monochromatic style, likely an engraving.

artworks.title: Hercules and Antaeus
artworks.description: There is a drawing of multiple human figures positioned dynamically. The central figure is holding another figure above its head effortlessly. Other figures surround them, in various poses of action or reaction. The lines are fluid and expressive, conveying tension and energy. The style is reminiscent of Giovanni Battista Piranesi's dramatic engravings and etchings.

artworks.title: Building in Ruins at the Side of a River
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient architectural site with partially ruined structures, set against a sky with clouds. A stream runs through the scene, with animals and a figure nearby. The drawing style uses hatching and cross-hatching for texture and shading. The color palette is monochromatic in brown and beige. Trees, figures, and livestock provide scale and activity to the scene.

artworks.title: Houses at the Side of a River
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with detailed architecture and natural elements visible from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon, mountains, clouds, buildings with arched windows and chimneys, river, tree, and stone bridge can be seen in intricate linework and delicate hatching. The monochromatic palette emphasizes the vintage quality of the scene.

artworks.title: Ruins on a Hilltop
artworks.description: The image features a landscape captured in an etching style, characterized by fine lines and detailed textures. The scene shows a tree on the left, a figure carrying sticks on the right, rushing water in between, trees in the distance, and a rocky structure near the center of the horizon. The color palette is limited to shades of black and white, creating depth and texture.

artworks.title: Sleeping Shepherd
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with ancient ruins featured prominently on the right side. The horizon is low, showcasing hills and a winding waterway in the distance. The scene is captured from an elevated point of view. The artwork is created through detailed etching, using fine lines for texture. The color palette is mainly black and white, with cross-hatching for shading. A shepherd and a small herd of sheep are shown on rocky terrain. Natural elements, such as a tree and rocks, balance the composition with the man-made structures.

artworks.title: Man and Ox in a River
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins with large stone structures, arches, and crumbling facades. In the background, there are trees, rocks, and a subtle horizon line. The etching technique uses fine lines to depict the details of the scene. The monochromatic color palette emphasizes black ink lines on a light background. A figure with a staff and a goat are near the water, adding scale and narrative to the landscape.

artworks.title: Louis XIII as Hercules
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a confident pose with one hand on his hip and the other resting on a club perched on his shoulder. The man's facial expression is serious, and he has long, curly hair that falls around his shoulders. He is dressed in a Roman-style short tunic with a lion's pelt draped over his shoulder, secured around his torso. To his left, there is a lion laying down, facing forward, and a rooster standing beside it. The foreground includes a book and some armor pieces lying on the ground. The background depicts a battle scene with soldiers on horseback and foot engaged in combat, with smoky chaos visible in the distance. Classical depictions of chariots riding on clouds are seen in the sky. The scene is surrounded by an ornate frame with decorative elements including foliage on the sides.
